title: CodeCaster
tagline: A comprehensive library for generating frames in one step and obtaining detailed analytics for them
description: Powered by Node.js and leveraging the capabilities of FrameJS and PinataFDK, this library offers seamless frame generation while integrating robust analytics functionalities controlled by Pinata. Currently supporting Base and Optimism networks, FarCaster Frames sets the standard as the ultimate frame library
